technical.summary: Bullish momentum with price structure strength and multiple MA confirmations, but weak trend confirmation (ADX 20.8) and overbought stochastic readings limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: OMC shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 34 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear zone (44 Fear/Greed) with bearish retail sentiment (45.8%) creates potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (15+ months old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (415.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event today, and 34-day earnings create a severely adverse macro backdrop for OMC.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + MACD bullish crossover + price above all major MAs create technical momentum setup with defined support at 69.35 in a fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (415.2), FOMC event today, 34-day earnings risk, weak ADX trend confirmation (20.8), zero fundamental/insider conviction, and price near resistance (70.82) with no triggered strategies create a hostile macro backdrop that overwhelms technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (three white soldiers, MACD crossover, price above MAs) offers defined support structure at 69.35, but this is insufficient to justify entry given macro headwinds.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (415.2) combined with FOMC event today and 34-day earnings creates severe tail risk that overwhelms technical setup; price near resistance (70.82) with weak ADX confirmation (20.8) offers poor risk/reward.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Zero sector concentration in Communication Services and no existing OMC position; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows flexibility, but macro environment does not warrant capital deployment here.
